svg.aria-label: Reverse-grip barbell curl, Setup: Hold the bar at shoulder width with palms facing down.
svg.title: Reverse-grip barbell curl, Setup: Hold the bar at shoulder width with palms facing down.

svg.title: Reverse-grip barbell curl, Top: Finish near your shoulders, palms still facing down.
